item.title: Rallying Cry – November 17, 2026
item.description: From Fela Kuti making history as the first African in the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame to Afghan women defying the Taliban with secret schools, plus Nigeria’s push for solar investment and a new Mohawk language school connecting students to their roots, today’s news is full of resilience and progress!
